reasoning_content: The form action contains an HTML entity `&` instead of `&`. We need to decode the HTML entity before using it. Let's fix this.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
set -e
FORM_ACTION=$(grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' dexform.html | head -1 | sed 's/action="//;s/"//' | sed 's/&/\&/g')
echo "FORM_ACTION=$FORM_ACTION"
curl -s -b dex_cookies.txt -c dex_cookies.txt \
  --data-urlencode "login=kai@example.com" --data-urlencode "password=changeme" \
  -D dexh.txt -o /dev/null -e "http://dex:5556${FORM_ACTION}" \
  "http://dex:5556${FORM_ACTION}"
echo "--- dexh ---"; cat dexh.txt | head
CB_URL=$(grep -i '^location:' dexh.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
echo "CB_URL: $CB_URL" | head -c 200; echo
echo "$CB_URL" > callback_url.txt
